title: Brandon Aiyuk posts another cryptic video calling out John Lynch, Kyle Shanahan: ‘We is not cool’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk posts another cryptic video calling out John Lynch, Kyle Shanahan: ‘We is not cool’
sources.description: 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk posted a video Saturday on his YouTube channel, claiming his former agent has influenced his situation with the team and 49ers general manager John Lynch recently showed up at his home.
